title: aquilaria moluccana
intro: Aquilaria moluccana, commonly known as agarwood or aloeswood, is a plant species that belongs to the Thymelaeaceae family. It is a slow-growing evergreen tree native to Southeast Asia, particularly in Indonesia and Malaysia. The resinous wood of Aquilaria moluccana has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, providing various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which help to alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and soothe skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of agarwood include agarol, aquilarin, and cyperene, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-depressant properties.
